request: Sixty-second build (incremental on the sixty-first, run 43571112825). Build 61 printed what gnrt vendors for MoltShield (1040 files: adblock 0.13.3 and its crates, the regenerated BUILD.gn files and Cargo.lock), and it is now committed in src/third_party/rust, so a Mac build needs no gnrt step. Every stage now vendors with the copy-back and fails, printing the tree, if gnrt's output differs from what is committed. The tests run, and the typed spoken suite.
